key.name: app-theme
key.description: Use CodexBar's dark navy appearance or inherit the GNOME Shell system theme.

key.name: warn-threshold
key.description: Usage percent above which bars and chips turn yellow.

key.name: crit-threshold
key.description: Usage percent above which bars and chips turn red.

key.name: chip-display-mode
key.description: What each panel chip shows: icon and progress ring, icon with ring and percent, icon with percent, name with ring and percent, or severity dot only.

key.name: merge-chips
key.description: Show a single chip with the worst window across all providers instead of one chip per provider.

key.name: show-reset-when-exhausted
key.description: When a provider's worst window is at 100%, the chip shows the time until reset instead of the percent.

key.name: bars-show-used
key.description: Usage bar foot shows "N% used"; off shows "N% remaining".

key.name: absolute-reset-times
key.description: Show reset moments as wall-clock times ("Resets 18:30") instead of countdowns ("Resets in 3h 12m").

key.name: hidden-chips
key.description: Provider ids whose chip is hidden from the panel; their card stays in the popover.

key.name: hidden-windows
key.summary: Usage bars hidden from the popover
key.description: Bar ids ("provider:key") whose usage bar is removed from the card.

key.name: hidden-cost-chart-providers
key.summary: Providers excluded from the cost chart
key.description: Provider ids excluded from the cost chart; at most four eligible providers are plotted.

key.name: known-windows
key.summary: Usage bars discovered at render time
key.description: Catalog the extension publishes for the preferences window; each entry is a JSON object {"p":provider,"k":key,"l":label}.

key.name: hidden-models
key.summary: Models left out of charts and model lists
key.description: "provider:model" entries hidden from chart bars, legends and model lists. Spend and token totals still include them.

key.name: model-colors
key.description: "provider:model" → "#rrggbb" overrides; models without one take the provider's brand color (largest) or the palette in rank order.

key.name: machine-colors
key.description: Machine id → "#rrggbb" overrides for the Machines tab; Machines without one take the palette by their place in the Sync Group.

key.name: known-models
key.summary: Models discovered in cost and sync data
key.description: Catalog the extension publishes for the preferences window; each entry is a JSON object {"p":provider,"m":model,"c":rounded 30-day cost}, ranked by cost within each provider.

key.name: status-scopes
key.description: "provider:scope" entries choosing which slice of the provider's status page the incident strip tracks; absent providers track their curated default from providermeta.js, or 'Everything'.

key.name: notify-enabled
key.description: Send a notification when a rate window crosses a notify threshold, once per threshold per reset cycle.

key.name: notify-session-thresholds
key.description: Percents at which short (session) windows notify, each once per reset cycle.

key.name: notify-weekly-thresholds
key.description: Percents at which long (weekly/monthly) windows notify, each once per reset cycle.

key.name: notify-pace-enabled
key.description: Notify when the pace projection says a window will hit 100% before it resets, once per reset cycle.

key.name: notify-sound
key.description: Play the system alert sound with quota notifications.

key.name: notify-muted-providers
key.description: Provider ids that never produce quota or pace notifications.

key.name: refresh-interval-secs
key.description: Seconds between codexbar serve's upstream fetches; changing it restarts the supervised serve child.

key.name: status-checks-enabled
key.description: Fetch public status-page incident feeds for the history strips; off hides the strips entirely.

key.name: sort-alphabetical
key.description: Order chips and tabs by display name instead of the CLI config order.

key.name: show-credits-extras
key.description: Show limit-reset credits and named extra rate windows (per-model and feature limits) on provider cards.

key.name: provider-order
key.description: Explicit list of provider IDs defining the display order in the popover and panel.

key.name: antigravity-overview-gemini
key.summary: Show Gemini models in Antigravity overview
key.description: Show Gemini 5h and weekly limits in the All view for Antigravity; off shows Claude and GPT limits instead.

key.name: providers-bootstrapped
key.description: Set once UsageBar has enabled the providers this user is signed in to and set the claude OAuth source.
